results.question: 基隆市有幾座電廠
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "電廠") AS "電廠數" FROM v_unit WHERE "縣市" = ? LIMIT 1

results.question: 有燃煤機組的電廠總共幾座
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "電廠") AS "總數" FROM v_unit WHERE "燃料" = ? LIMIT 1

results.question: 機組數第二多的電廠
results.sql: SELECT "電廠", COUNT(*) AS "機組數" FROM v_unit GROUP BY "電廠" ORDER BY "機組數" DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

results.question: 總裝置容量第三大的電廠是哪一座
各電廠最晚商轉的機組是哪一天商轉的
results.sql: SELECT "電廠", MAX("商轉日期") AS "最晚商轉日期" FROM v_unit GROUP BY "電廠" ORDER BY "最晚商轉日期" DESC LIMIT 200

results.question: 每個縣市單一機組最大的裝置容量
results.sql: SELECT SUBSTRING("縣市", 1, 3) AS "縣市", MAX("裝置容量_萬瓩") AS "最大裝置容量_萬瓩" FROM v_unit GROUP BY SUBSTRING("縣市", 1, 3) ORDER BY "最大裝置容量_萬瓩" DESC LIMIT 200

results.question: 同時有煤和天然氣機組的電廠
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT "電廠" FROM v_unit WHERE "燃料" IN (?, ?) AND "電廠" IN (SELECT "電廠" FROM v_unit WHERE "燃料" IN (?, ?) GROUP BY "電廠" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "燃料") = 2) ORDER BY "電廠" LIMIT 200

results.question: 哪些電廠既有重油機組也有輕柴油機組
results.sql: SELECT "電廠" FROM v_unit WHERE "燃料" IN (?, ?) GROUP BY "電廠" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "燃料") = 2 ORDER BY "電廠" LIMIT 10

results.question: 只有一部機組的電廠有哪些
results.sql: SELECT "電廠" FROM v_unit GROUP BY "電廠" HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 ORDER BY "電廠" LIMIT 100

results.question: 1990年代商轉的機組有幾部
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "機組數" FROM v_unit WHERE "商轉日期" BETWEEN ? AND ? LIMIT 1

results.question: 商轉日期只記到月份的機組有幾部
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "機組數" FROM v_unit WHERE "商轉日期精度" = ? LIMIT 1

results.question: 每個縣市有幾種燃料的機組
results.sql: SELECT SUBSTRING("縣市", 1, 3) AS "縣市", COUNT(DISTINCT "燃料") AS "機組數" FROM v_unit GROUP BY SUBSTRING("縣市", 1, 3) ORDER BY SUBSTRING("縣市", 1, 3) LIMIT 100

results.question: 總裝置容量超過200萬瓩的電廠有幾座
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "電廠") AS "電廠數" FROM v_unit WHERE "裝置容量_萬瓩" > 200 LIMIT 1

results.question: 最早有機組商轉的電廠是哪一座
results.sql: SELECT "電廠" FROM v_unit WHERE "商轉日期" = (SELECT MIN("商轉日期") FROM v_unit) LIMIT 1

results.question: 起訖日期有誤的歲修有幾筆
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_outage WHERE "日期狀態" = ? LIMIT 200

results.question: 同時有燃煤和燃氣歲修的電廠
results.sql: SELECT "電廠" FROM v_outage WHERE "日期狀態" = ? AND "燃料" IN (?, ?) AND SUBSTR("開始日期", 1, 7) IN (SELECT SUBSTR("開始日期", 1, 7) FROM v_outage WHERE "燃料" IN (?, ?) GROUP BY SUBSTR("開始日期", 1, 7) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "燃料") = 2) GROUP BY "電廠" HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "日期狀態") = 2 ORDER BY "電廠" LIMIT 200

results.question: 對應到多部機組、有歧義的歲修有幾筆
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "數量" FROM (SELECT "歲修編號", "機組名", "電廠", "燃料", "開始日期", "結束日期", "原因", "日期狀態", "對齊狀態" FROM v_outage WHERE "日期狀態" = ? AND "對齊狀態" = ?) LIMIT 1

results.question: 2025年風力發電量第二多的場站
results.sql: SELECT "發電站", SUM("發電量_度") AS "總發電量_度" FROM v_re_generation WHERE "能源別" LIKE ? AND "年度" = ? GROUP BY "發電站" ORDER BY "總發電量_度" DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

results.question: 每種能源別各有幾座場站
results.sql: SELECT "能源別", COUNT(*) AS "場站數" FROM v_re_generation GROUP BY "能源別" ORDER BY "場站數" DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: 每座風力場站最近一筆發電紀錄是哪一年
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT "發電站", MAX("月份") AS "最近月份" FROM v_re_generation WHERE "能源別" LIKE ? GROUP BY "發電站" ORDER BY "最近月份" DESC LIMIT 200

results.question: 2026年7月10日燃氣類別尖峰出力最高的機組欄位
results.sql: SELECT "機組欄位", "尖峰出力_萬瓩" FROM v_peak WHERE "日期" = ? AND "類別" = ? ORDER BY "尖峰出力_萬瓩" DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: 2025年8月1日各類別的尖峰出力加總
results.sql: SELECT "類別", SUM("尖峰出力_萬瓩") AS "尖峰出力加總_萬瓩" FROM v_peak WHERE "日期" BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY "類別" ORDER BY SUM("尖峰出力_萬瓩") DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: 2026年7月10日尖峰出力第二高的機組欄位
results.sql: SELECT "機組欄位", "尖峰出力_萬瓩" FROM v_peak WHERE "日期" = ? ORDER BY "尖峰出力_萬瓩" DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

results.question: 機組數介於5到10部之間的電廠
results.sql: SELECT "電廠", COUNT(*) AS "機組數" FROM v_unit GROUP BY "電廠" HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN ? AND ? ORDER BY COUNT(*) LIMIT 10

results.question: 歲修筆數最多的電廠
results.sql: SELECT "電廠", COUNT(*) AS "歲修筆數" FROM v_outage GROUP BY "電廠" ORDER BY "歲修筆數" DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: 原因寫著大修的歲修有幾筆
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "筆數" FROM v_outage WHERE "原因" LIKE ? LIMIT 1
